This year’s focus will be on the “The Evolution of
Freighting on the Santa Fe Trail” and will examine
how freighting developed during the 60 years that
trade goods flowed along this historic route. It will
also focus on the economic, social and cultural
backgrounds of those who participated in the trade
between Missouri and Santa Fe.
